description: Ministry of Power, Energy & Business Development - Order to acquire the land in Galatha, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District for Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for the Ceylon Electricity Board. It specifically describes the acquisition of a 2.5-hectare land parcel, including its boundaries, location details (Grama Niladhari Division, Divisional Secretariat, District), and references a layout plan. While a minister is named, this is solely in the context of approving the land acquisition under specific legislation, making this a land/property matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
